experiment_name: Minimal 1-game PPO checkpoint for MonopolyZero format/architecture compatibility

algorithm_config.goal: checkpoint format/architecture compatibility only, not policy strength

result: Trained the smallest possible PPO checkpoint (1 game) purely to satisfy MonopolyZeroNet.load_ppo_actor's format/metadata requirements (format_version=3, ruleset, state_dim, action_dim, hidden_dim=256) - not a strength claim. Saved directly to the submodule's own gitignored artifacts/ directory at the exact path monopoly_bench.cli.smoke() hardcodes as DEFAULT_PPO; git -C references/DeepRL_Monopoly status --short stayed empty before and after, confirming the submodule stayed read-only.
notes: integrity.fallbacks is null: PPO training's fixed opponents are substituted inline in monopoly_game_engine/train.py without an exposed fallback counter, same schema gap as the DDQN training entries (002, 004).
